mapper.select: SELECT o.Order_ID, o.Quantity, o.Time_purchased, o.Time_filled, o.Purchase_Price, o.Status AS OrderStatus_ID, os.OrderStatus_Name, c.Client_ID, c.email AS client_email, c.cash_balance AS client_cash_balance, c.password_hash AS client_password_hash, c.street_address AS client_street_address, c.phone_number AS client_phone_number, c.ssn AS client_ssn, i.Instrument_ID, i.Symbol AS instrument_symbol, i.Symbol_Name AS instrument_symbol_name FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Order_Status os ON o.Status = os.OrderStatus_ID LEFT JOIN Clients c ON o.Client_ID = c.Client_ID LEFT JOIN Instruments i ON o.Instrument_ID = i.Instrument_ID WHERE o.Order_ID = #{id}

SELECT o.Order_ID, o.Quantity, o.Time_purchased, o.Time_filled, o.Purchase_Price, o.Status AS OrderStatus_ID, os.OrderStatus_Name, c.Client_ID, c.email AS client_email, c.cash_balance AS client_cash_balance, c.password_hash AS client_password_hash, c.street_address AS client_street_address, c.phone_number AS client_phone_number, c.ssn AS client_ssn, i.Instrument_ID, i.Symbol AS instrument_symbol, i.Symbol_Name AS instrument_symbol_name FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Order_Status os ON o.Status = os.OrderStatus_ID LEFT JOIN Clients c ON o.Client_ID = c.Client_ID LEFT JOIN Instruments i ON o.Instrument_ID = i.Instrument_ID

SELECT o.Order_ID, o.Quantity, o.Time_purchased, o.Time_filled, o.Purchase_Price, o.Status AS OrderStatus_ID, os.OrderStatus_Name, c.Client_ID, c.email AS client_email, c.cash_balance AS client_cash_balance, c.password_hash AS client_password_hash, c.street_address AS client_street_address, c.phone_number AS client_phone_number, c.ssn AS client_ssn, i.Instrument_ID, i.Symbol AS instrument_symbol, i.Symbol_Name AS instrument_symbol_name FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Order_Status os ON o.Status = os.OrderStatus_ID LEFT JOIN Clients c ON o.Client_ID = c.Client_ID LEFT JOIN Instruments i ON o.Instrument_ID = i.Instrument_ID WHERE c.Client_ID = #{clientId} ORDER BY o.Time_purchased ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Orders (Client_ID, Instrument_ID, Quantity, Time_purchased, Time_filled, Purchase_Price, Status) VALUES (#{client.id}, #{instrument.id}, #{quantity}, #{timeOfPurchase}, #{timeFilled}, #{purchasePrice}, #{status.id})
mapper.update: UPDATE Orders SET Client_ID = #{client.id}, Instrument_ID = #{instrument.id}, Quantity = #{quantity}, Time_purchased = #{timeOfPurchase}, Time_filled = #{timeFilled}, Purchase_Price = #{purchasePrice}, Status = #{status.id} WHERE Order_ID = #{id}
